_comment: Goal 2: DMM REL / probe-zero. Long-press HOLD (raw bit16 -> id16) captures the current reading as an offset; the display shows value-offset with a 'REL' marker; same long-press clears it; auto-clears if function/range changes. Code in the dead CJK glyph area 0x66400 (after the Goal-4 streaming cave). Offset/flag/captured-fn/range in proven-unused RAM (0x20000FDC/0x200005FB/0x20000609/0x2000060A). Verified by unicorn emulation; see notes/re-plan.md. Composes on top of dmm-first, the language builds and dmm-stream.
